strengths: INSS has a structured rule source in data/rules/inss.json.
scripts/transform-rules.js validates equivalence against the runtime aggregate.
Compatibility and dependency maps identify affected tools and sources.
gaps: The public runtime consumes data/tabelas-trabalhistas.json rather than data/rules/inss.json directly.
Some calculator pages still contain hardcoded INSS fallback constants.
Core is documented as not connected to runtime in compatibility maps.
futureTarget: data/rules/inss.json or a Core-approved equivalent should become the governed canonical source, with generated runtime aggregates and no divergent fallback constants.
